headline: Thursday Price Change at Stations. Diesel Getting Closer to the 7 zł Limit
summary: Poland's energy minister set maximum fuel prices for Thursday, 26 November, at PLN 5.82 for Pb95 petrol and PLN 7.15 for diesel per litre. Diesel prices are rising toward PLN 7.
why: Fuel prices feed directly into transport costs and inflation, and Poland regulates maximum retail prices through periodic official announcements.
original_headline: W czwartek zmiana na stacjach. Diesel coraz bliżej granicy 7 zł
